primary_paper.title: Experimental investigation of hydrogen release from a high pressure vessel

jari_jhfc_archive_route.project_scope: JHFC public archive describes station/FCV demonstration reports and seminars
jari_jhfc_archive_route.finding: The public JHFC/JARI route exposes project reports and context, but the reported report index is unavailable and no Grüne 2014 pressure-time file or supplementary raw trace was found.

source_review.search_scope: KIT 공식 레코드, ScienceDirect 논문 랜딩, H2Tools 공개 사본 및 표적 raw-data 검색
source_review.h2tools_finding: The H2Tools copy confirms the experiment description and plotted pressure-decay context but does not expose a reusable complete machine-readable pressure-time trace or a data-redistribution licence.

latest_official_record_recheck.finding: KITopen 레코드에서 논문 DOI·저자·연도·저널 정보는 확인했으나, 공개된 기계판독 압력-시간 원자료 또는 재사용 조건은 확인하지 못함

existing_trace.coverage: early pressure decay only; the digitized curve does not reach the required half-pressure crossing

findings.latest_recheck_2026_10_14: 공식 레코드와 공개 사본을 재확인했으나 기존 51점 도식화 곡선을 넘어서는 완전한 압력-시간 원자료는 확인되지 않음

decision.next_evidence: KIT custodian으로부터 완전한 방출 종료점을 포함한 권리 확인 압력-시간 원자료를 받아, 수치 접근 전에 새 프로토콜을 고정

claim_boundary: This recheck documents a public-source search and preserves the existing negative/insufficient trace result. It does not validate pressure decay, vessel discharge, station control, dispersion, ignition, safety distance, or full-loop fueling.
